quests.title: Hyakunin Ikki: Golden Whirlwind

dialogue.sit: Do you have a commission for me?

dialogue.t: Um, your blond hair looks familiar... Are you...
Ah yes! You are the eye-catching Golden Whirlwind from the Hyakunin Ikki last time...

Previously, I was watching the excellent performances of the participants in a corner of the tournament venue, seeking to be inspired by the most thrilling fighting scenes. And there you were, taking out opponents like a golden whirlwind sweeping away weeds and grass...

dialogue.sit: Ugh, please, spare me the flattery.

dialogue.t: Anyway, some people have organized another Hyakunin Ikki recently.

It's a free-for-all tournament whereby people engage in a hearty fight to celebrate, or simply to eliminate bad luck. It's a festival where both martial artists and monsters put their grievances aside and forget their identities, just to enjoy the sheer excitement of fighting.
They say that those who stand out from the crowd will be awarded various treasures.
The identities of the organizers and sponsors are still shrouded in mystery though.
Whatever the case, this is not a topic to be discussed out in the open. Follow me...
Once we enter this suspicious-looking gate, we'll be in the tournament venue for this iteration of Hyakunin Ikki.

The rules probably have not changed much. Monsters, adventurers, and warriors from across the world, who share a common yearning for fight, will quench their thirst on this stage through passionate battle.
Just like last time, feel free to bring your friends and companions! After all, the "Hyakunin" in "Hyakunin Ikki" means the more, the merrier!
I'm looking forward to your performance.

dialogue.sit: Are you not going to participate this time either?

dialogue.t: Oh, of course I will — as a spectator, cheering you on!
After all, what I aspire to do is write the most thrilling action novels, not become a gallant warrior like you.
...And my gut tells me that your star will shine brightest in this arena.
Yes, I'm sure you'll show me the most dazzling blade-dance again this time.

quests.description: It’s been a while since the last Hyakunin Ikki. Kayabuki shows up again in Inazuma…
